hook_line: MOHAMMED SHAMI RETIRES FROM TEST CRICKET AFTER 229 WICKETS

hook_stat.sub: Test wickets in 64 matches for India

diaspora_bullets: Fifth-highest wicket-taker among Indian fast bowlers in Tests
His last Test was the 2023 World Test Championship final
news_summary: Shami announced his Test retirement on November 6, 13 years after his debut.
payoff: Shami will continue playing white-ball cricket, including the IPL.
